## Review: PR #12 — feat(search): add fuzzy search helpers

**Assessment:** Adds fuzzy search helpers to plugin-search (+185/-2). Overlaps significantly with PR #16 which implements a more complete fuzzy search with fzf-like scoring. 

**Recommendation:** If PR #16 is merged first, this PR will likely conflict or become redundant. Suggest closing in favor of #16 which has a more thorough implementation (scoring algorithm, match indices, UI toggle).

issue_comments.body:
### Code review

Thanks for the contribution. A few notes on the diff itself, then a coordination concern that prompts closing this PR in favor of #16.

Implementation notes (all lower-confidence, none catastrophic):

- **"Smallest line-local window" guarantee can fail for queries with repeated first characters.** `findFuzzyWindow` does a forward greedy pass to locate the end of the subsequence, then a backward shrink. The backward shrink walks all the way to the first occurrence of `needle[0]` from the left, even if a later occurrence would yield a smaller window. Example: query `"aba"` against `"aabba"` returns `{from:0, to:5}` ("aabba"), but the smallest valid window is `{from:1, to:5}` ("abba"). No test covers repeated-character queries, so the README's "smallest contiguous text window" guarantee is unverified.

https://github.com/floatboatai/Nexus-Editor/blob/ff33917f7b58883414d0460d2afcddb82079b5a9/packages/plugin-search/src/index.ts

- **`SearchOptions.fuzzy` is programmatic-only.** No `SearchPluginOptions.fuzzy`, no `SearchPluginLabels.fuzzy`, no panel toggle. For a user-facing roadmap item (#17), the UI wiring is the more impactful half.

- **New public capability without OpenSpec proposal.** Per the root `CLAUDE.md`, "Always open @/openspec/AGENTS.md when the request: Introduces new capabilities." Sibling PRs #13/#14/#15 follow that pattern.

Coordination — why closing:

PR #16 (already merged-ready / reviewed by maintainer) implements the same Roadmap #17 fuzzy search but takes a more complete approach: it ships a separate `packages/core/src/fuzzy.ts` with fzf-style word-boundary/prefix/contiguous bonuses and gap penalty, exposes `fuzzyFilter`/`fuzzyMatch` as core primitives, AND wires the toggle through the search panel UI. Both PRs textually modify `packages/plugin-search/src/index.ts` and `packages/plugin-search/test/plugin-search.test.ts`, and both flip Roadmap #17 in `docs/ROADMAP.md` — they will conflict at merge.

Closing this PR in favor of #16. The line-local window idea here is interesting and complementary — if you'd like to pick up #16's stalls (its panel toggle is currently dead UI, `replaceAllMatches` isn't updated for fuzzy, and the match-shape needs work — see [my review on #16](https://github.com/floatboatai/Nexus-Editor/pull/16#issuecomment-4447439684)), a follow-up PR addressing those would be very welcome.

Thanks again for the work — the algorithm sketch and tests here are useful reference material for the follow-up.
